_notes: Arathi Highlands named-boss and rare loot. ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = creature level + 3. Names and stat intent are hand-authored in tools/build_arathi_boss_loot.py; the NUMBERS are solved from LootGenerator's own budget formula there - do not hand-edit this file, edit SPECS and re-run.

Boulderfist Hal'dun.name: Hal'dun's Ringbreaker
Boulderfist Hal'dun.flavor_text: The ogres have been taking the standing stones down for forty years and are not quick.

Boulderfist Hal'dun.name: Hold-Chief's Platemail
Boulderfist Hal'dun.flavor_text: Four smiths' work, none of them ogres, none of them willing.

Boulderfist Hal'dun.name: Ringwall Sabatons
Boulderfist Hal'dun.flavor_text: The hold's outer wall is a stone circle with mud packed into the gaps.

Boulderfist Hal'dun.name: Idol-Breaker's Charm
Boulderfist Hal'dun.flavor_text: He wears one of the smaller stones. It has stopped doing whatever it did.

Brinemaw.name: Brinemaw's Loose Tooth
Brinemaw.flavor_text: It grows them back. The ones it loses wash up barbed, which teeth are not.

Brinemaw.name: Gill-Rent Scalemail
Brinemaw.flavor_text: Scraped off the thing and cured. It has never stopped smelling of the sump.

Brinemaw.name: Deep-Sump Shoulderpads
Brinemaw.flavor_text: The sump at the Tidewrack is open water and goes down further than the cave does.

Brinemaw.name: Lure of the Pearl Floor
Brinemaw.flavor_text: Something down there is arranging them. In rows.

Captain Mory Vane.name: Vane's Long Nine
Captain Mory Vane.flavor_text: She took the hold from the sea side, which nobody had thought was a side.

Captain Mory Vane.name: Captain's Storm-Cut Leathers
Captain Mory Vane.flavor_text: Cut short at the knee for climbing a wet rock face in the dark.

Captain Mory Vane.name: Reaver's Boarding Spurs
Captain Mory Vane.flavor_text: For going up a hull. Used going up a cliff more often now.

Captain Mory Vane.name: Bloodsail Captain's Band
Captain Mory Vane.flavor_text: The Bloodsail gave her a ring instead of a ship. She took the hold instead.

Gor'mok the Pit Chief.name: Pit-Chief's Knucklebar
Gor'mok the Pit Chief.flavor_text: The pit at Boulder'gor is a hole with a lip on it. He has never lost in it.

Gor'mok the Pit Chief.name: Ring-Scarred Jerkin
Gor'mok the Pit Chief.flavor_text: Worn by everyone who fought him. Taken off everyone who fought him.

Gor'mok the Pit Chief.name: Deepden Treads
Gor'mok the Pit Chief.flavor_text: The floor down there is packed by generations of the same few steps.

Gor'mok the Pit Chief.name: Trophy of the Standing Count
Gor'mok the Pit Chief.flavor_text: He keeps count out loud. The number is much higher than the number of bodies.

Grevan the Gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper's Barred Shield
Grevan the Gatekeeper.flavor_text: The gate has not opened in three years. He is still being paid to not open it.

Grevan the Gatekeeper.name: Portcullis Pauldrons
Grevan the Gatekeeper.flavor_text: Something very heavy came down on the left one and stopped.

Grevan the Gatekeeper.name: Warden's Chainmail Coif
Grevan the Gatekeeper.flavor_text: Stromgarde issue. The crest has been filed off and not replaced with another.

Grevan the Gatekeeper.name: Keyring of the Outer Ward
Grevan the Gatekeeper.flavor_text: Eleven keys. Four of the doors they open are no longer standing.

Grubbis Tallow.name: Tallow's Guttering Wand
Grubbis Tallow.flavor_text: A candle he has never let go out, in a holder he has never let anyone else carry.

Grubbis Tallow.name: Chandler's Waxed Robes
Grubbis Tallow.flavor_text: Dipped, not woven. Years of dipping.

Grubbis Tallow.name: Wick-Trimmer's Gloves
Grubbis Tallow.flavor_text: Kobolds are frightened of the dark in a way that is not a joke to them.

Grubbis Tallow.name: Dripstone Loop
Grubbis Tallow.flavor_text: Wax, over bone, over wax. He has been making it his whole life.

Gruln Stonejaw.name: Stonejaw's Quarry Cleaver
Gruln Stonejaw.flavor_text: Not forged. Found, and then argued with for a long time.

Gruln Stonejaw.name: Crag-Walker's Girdle
Gruln Stonejaw.flavor_text: An ogre's belt makes a human's chest-piece, which is how the Syndicate used them.

Gruln Stonejaw.name: Boulderfist Knuckle-Plate
Gruln Stonejaw.flavor_text: Three fingers of it. The fourth was never made and was never missed.

Gruln Stonejaw.name: Stoneheart Pendant
Gruln Stonejaw.flavor_text: Ogres do not wear jewellery. He wore this one, and did not say where it came from.

Harbinger Veska.name: Witherbark Harbinger's Totem
Harbinger Veska.flavor_text: Carved facing away from the village, which is not how they are usually carved.

Harbinger Veska.name: Hollow-Drum Shoulderguards
Harbinger Veska.flavor_text: The hide is from something that was not a deer and the drum was not for dancing.

Harbinger Veska.name: Hexthread Leggings
Harbinger Veska.flavor_text: Six colours of thread, and the sixth is not a dye anyone sells.

Harbinger Veska.name: Charm of the Turned Ear
Harbinger Veska.flavor_text: Trolls bury these at the edge of a camp to hear what is coming. Hers faced in.

Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.name: Ashkin's Accounting Crossbow
Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.flavor_text: He writes down every bolt. He writes down what it was spent on.

Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.name: Purser's Oilskin Coat
Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.flavor_text: Three years of salt and the ink inside the breast pocket has never run.

Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.name: Shelf-Clerk's Cuffs
Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.flavor_text: A pirate crew that keeps books keeps them somewhere dry and high up.

Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.name: Weighted Cargo-Seal
Ledger-Keeper Ashkin.flavor_text: Stamped on every crate on the shelf. Half the crates are not theirs.

Lord Falconcrest.name: Falconcrest's Court Blade
Lord Falconcrest.flavor_text: A duelling sword, in a keep with no court left to duel in.

Lord Falconcrest.name: Pretender's Breastplate
Lord Falconcrest.flavor_text: The Stromgarde arms, re-engraved with his own. Badly, and by his own hand.

Lord Falconcrest.name: Mantle of the Third Claimant
Lord Falconcrest.flavor_text: Two others claimed this hall before him. He does not mention them by name.

Lord Falconcrest.name: Falconer's Hooded Band
Lord Falconcrest.flavor_text: The bird it was made for has been loose over the moor for years.

Mauler Krakk.name: Krakk's Rendering Maul
Mauler Krakk.flavor_text: He has worn a groove into the floor where he sets it down.

Mauler Krakk.name: Maulhide Shoulders
Mauler Krakk.flavor_text: Cured in the hold's own runoff, which is why nobody else wants them.

Mauler Krakk.name: Bone-Set Gauntlets
Mauler Krakk.flavor_text: The setting is not decorative. It is how an ogre makes a glove fit a human hand.

Mauler Krakk.name: Mauler's Weighted Cord
Mauler Krakk.flavor_text: Heavier than it needs to be. That was the point of it.

Old Bonepicker.name: Bonepicker's Longbow
Old Bonepicker.flavor_text: Taken off the last person who tried. Left on the flat for the next one.

Old Bonepicker.name: Scavenger's Patchwork Vest
Old Bonepicker.flavor_text: Nine kinds of leather. None of them cut from the same animal, or the same decade.

Old Bonepicker.name: Pickings Girdle
Old Bonepicker.flavor_text: The flat it nests on is above the tide and the tide keeps bringing it work.

Old Bonepicker.name: Keenest Eye
Old Bonepicker.flavor_text: It watched the whole wreck happen and then waited for the water to go down.

Overseer Mull.name: Go'Shek Tally-Mace
Overseer Mull.flavor_text: The farm still files its yield. Nobody has come to collect it in three years.

Overseer Mull.name: Overseer's Buckled Hauberk
Overseer Mull.flavor_text: Let out twice at the straps. He was a smaller man when he was given it.

Overseer Mull.name: Fieldhand's Bound Wraps
Overseer Mull.flavor_text: The people who worked this ground wore these. He kept a pair.

Overseer Mull.name: Signet of the Lost Rent
Overseer Mull.flavor_text: A seal for a ledger that was already a lie when it was sealed.

Overseer Ratch.name: Ratch's Shift-Ending Axe
Overseer Ratch.flavor_text: The shift ends when he says. He has not said for a while.

Overseer Ratch.name: Overseer's Lamplit Harness
Overseer Ratch.flavor_text: Four lamp-hooks across the shoulders. You can see him coming along a gallery.

Overseer Ratch.name: Tally-Scratch Bracers
Overseer Ratch.flavor_text: The marks on the inside are a count of days. They stop, then start again lower.

Overseer Ratch.name: Whistle of the Lower Shift
Overseer Ratch.flavor_text: The diggers still come when it blows. It is not clear that they want to.

Silt-Mother Ooga.name: Silt-Mother's Spawning Idol
Silt-Mother Ooga.flavor_text: The mere is shallow, warm, and full. Those three facts are the same fact.

Silt-Mother Ooga.name: Mireclutch Hauberk
Silt-Mother Ooga.flavor_text: It drains for about an hour after you take it out of the water.

Silt-Mother Ooga.name: Brood-Slick Grips
Silt-Mother Ooga.flavor_text: The grip is better wet, which is not how grips usually work.

Silt-Mother Ooga.name: Pearl of the Drowned Mere
Silt-Mother Ooga.flavor_text: Freshwater. Something in there is making them anyway.

Sister Mollis.name: Libram of the Kept Vigil
Sister Mollis.flavor_text: She has read the evening office every evening. The chapel roof went two winters ago.

Sister Mollis.name: Vestments of the Shuttered Chapel
Sister Mollis.flavor_text: Clean. In all of this, clean.

Sister Mollis.name: Almsgiver's Clasped Belt
Sister Mollis.flavor_text: The pouch is empty and the clasp is worn from being opened.

Sister Mollis.name: Censer of Grey Smoke
Sister Mollis.flavor_text: Whatever she is burning now is not incense and she knows it is not.

Thane Aldric's Shade.name: Aldric's Oathkeeping Sword
Thane Aldric's Shade.flavor_text: He swore to hold the eastern march. He is still at it, which is the problem.

Thane Aldric's Shade.name: Thane's Barrow-Plate
Thane Aldric's Shade.flavor_text: Arathor work. There is no smith alive who could repair it and he does not need one.

Thane Aldric's Shade.name: Pall of the Long Watch
Thane Aldric's Shade.flavor_text: Buried with him, under four feet of standing water, facing the door.

Thane Aldric's Shade.name: March-Lord's Ring of Office
Thane Aldric's Shade.flavor_text: The march it is an office of is a drowned field with ogres walking over it.

The Barrow Warden.name: Warden's Mausoleum Pavis
The Barrow Warden.flavor_text: A door-shield. It was a door first.

The Barrow Warden.name: Grave-Marble Legplates
The Barrow Warden.flavor_text: The barrow's upper floor is marble. Below the stair it is limestone and wet.

The Barrow Warden.name: Sepulchre Helm
The Barrow Warden.flavor_text: No eye-slit worth the name. Whatever is in it is not looking out of it.

The Barrow Warden.name: Cerement Bindings
The Barrow Warden.flavor_text: Linen. Three years of it holding, in water, is not a thing linen does.

The Pick-Mother.name: Pick-Mother's Splitting Fang
The Pick-Mother.flavor_text: Kobolds hand their picks down. This one has been handed down past being a pick.

The Pick-Mother.name: Brood-Gallery Chainmail
The Pick-Mother.flavor_text: Sized for something that grows. Let out at the seams four times.

The Pick-Mother.name: Spoil-Heap Treads
The Pick-Mother.flavor_text: Mine spoil is loose, sharp and moves under you. These do not.

The Pick-Mother.name: Nursery Candle-Stub
The Pick-Mother.flavor_text: The deepest gallery is the warm one. That is where she keeps them.

The Ring Warden.name: Warden's Plumbline Stave
The Ring Warden.flavor_text: The rings are not a calendar and not a grave. The Warden is still measuring which.

The Ring Warden.name: Mantle of the Fourth Circle
The Ring Warden.flavor_text: There are four rings. Three are quiet.

The Ring Warden.name: Lodestone Girdle
The Ring Warden.flavor_text: Stand in the ring wearing this and you can feel which way the stones are facing.

The Ring Warden.name: Sighting-Ring of the Basin
The Ring Warden.flavor_text: Hold it up at the right spot and all four circles line up. Nobody built that twice.

The Saltquern.name: The Turning Stone
The Saltquern.flavor_text: A mill-wheel for grinding salt out of the shallows. Nobody has turned it in years.

The Saltquern.name: Saltcrust Carapace
The Saltquern.flavor_text: Not worn. Grown, over whatever is turning the wheel.

The Saltquern.name: Brinehardened Boots
The Saltquern.flavor_text: Standing in salt water does this to leather over about a decade.

The Saltquern.name: Grinding-Stone Fragment
The Saltquern.flavor_text: The wheel is down to three quarters of itself and is still going round.

The Vault-Thing.name: Tome of the Lower Stair
The Vault-Thing.flavor_text: Stromgarde was built on top of this. The undercroft is the part that was here first.

The Vault-Thing.name: Vaultkeeper's Mouldered Robe
The Vault-Thing.flavor_text: Cut for a human frame, and the frame inside it is close enough to be worse.

The Vault-Thing.name: Gravelight Bracers
The Vault-Thing.flavor_text: They give off nothing you could read by. You can still tell when they are near.

The Vault-Thing.name: Coffer-Seal of Arathor
The Vault-Thing.flavor_text: The empire that sealed this did not record what it was sealing.

The Wrack-Drowned.name: Drowned Lantern-Pole
The Wrack-Drowned.flavor_text: Carried out to the tideline to look for survivors. It came back. They did not.

The Wrack-Drowned.name: Shroud of the Standing Tide
The Wrack-Drowned.flavor_text: The water in there comes up twice a day and has nowhere to go.

The Wrack-Drowned.name: Wracklight Handwraps
The Wrack-Drowned.flavor_text: What is on them is not phosphorescence and does not come off in fresh water.

The Wrack-Drowned.name: Keepsake of the Undertow
The Wrack-Drowned.flavor_text: Everyone drowned here was carrying one of something. This is the one that was kept.

What They Dug Into.name: Blade From Below the Sump
What They Dug Into.flavor_text: The kobolds did not make this and did not want to find it. They were digging for ore.

What They Dug Into.name: Scale of the Thing in the Water
What They Dug Into.flavor_text: Not plate. Worn as plate, because there is nothing else to call it.

What They Dug Into.name: Sumpwater Crown
What They Dug Into.flavor_text: The sump has been filling since before the mine. The mine found the top of it.

What They Dug Into.name: What the Deep Floor Gave Up
What They Dug Into.flavor_text: Nobody in Drywhisker will say its name, and not out of respect.
